title: Daily Memory Capture Gap
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=photo:capture OR sourcetype=voicememo:note OR sourcetype=lifelog:moment)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(sourcetype) as capture_modes, count as captures by _time
| where captures<2
| sort _time
description: Finds days with very little recorded memory capture across photos, voice memos, and life-log entries.
value: Not every day needs curation, but gap days reveal whether your logging habit is too brittle to be reliable.
implementation: Combine the main life-log sourcetypes and identify low-capture days after daily binning.
visualization: Table of low-capture days with capture count and modes used.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which days barely got recorded at all across your memory tools.
